title: Data Adapters and Types
summary: This module provides a flexible adapter system for interacting with Language Models (LMs) and defines various custom data types for rich, structured LM inputs and outputs. It enables seamless integration of DSPy programs with diverse LM capabilities, including native function calling and structured data extraction.

nodes.label: Base Adapter for LM Interaction
nodes.title: Adapter
nodes.description: Provides the core interface for transforming DSPy signatures and inputs into LM prompts, handling LM calls, and parsing responses back into structured outputs. Supports native LM features like function calling and citations.

nodes.label: Pydantic Model Formatting Adapter
nodes.title: BAMLAdapter
nodes.description: Extends the base adapter to improve rendering of complex Pydantic models for LMs, generating a compact, human-readable schema with field descriptions for better token efficiency and LM understanding.

nodes.label: Two-Stage Extraction Adapter
nodes.title: TwoStepAdapter
nodes.description: Implements a two-stage process: a main LM generates a natural language response, and a smaller, dedicated LM extracts structured data from that response. Ideal for reasoning models that struggle with direct structured output.

nodes.label: Base for Custom Data Types
nodes.title: Type
nodes.description: The foundational class for defining custom data types within DSPy signatures. Subclasses implement methods to format data for LM consumption and handle serialization/deserialization.

nodes.label: Audio Data Type
nodes.title: Audio
nodes.description: Represents audio data, typically base64 encoded. Provides utilities to create audio objects from URLs, files, or arrays, and formats them for inclusion in LM prompts.

nodes.label: Code Snippet Data Type
nodes.title: Code
nodes.description: Encapsulates code snippets, useful for tasks like code generation or analysis. Formats code for direct inclusion in prompts, often with language-specific markdown.

nodes.label: Document Data Type for Citations
nodes.title: Document
nodes.description: Represents textual documents with optional titles and context, designed for citation-enabled LM interactions. Formats documents for LM consumption, allowing models to reference sources.

nodes.label: File Data Type
nodes.title: File
nodes.description: Represents file content, typically as a data URI or file ID. Provides methods to create file objects from paths or bytes, and formats them for LM input.

nodes.label: Image Data Type
nodes.title: Image
nodes.description: Represents image data, usually as a URL or base64 encoded data URI. Offers methods to create image objects from various sources and formats them for multimodal LM prompts.

nodes.label: Callable Tool Data Type
nodes.title: Tool
nodes.description: Simplifies the creation and integration of callable functions as tools for LMs. Infers tool metadata from Python functions and formats them for native function calling APIs.

nodes.label: Citation Information Type
nodes.title: Citations
nodes.description: Represents structured citation information, including cited text and document references. Used by adapters to handle native citation features of LMs and parse citation outputs.

nodes.label: Tool Call Information Type
nodes.title: ToolCalls
nodes.description: Represents structured information about tool calls made by an LM, including tool name and arguments. Used by adapters to parse native function calling outputs.

nodes.label: Language Model (External)
nodes.title: BaseLM
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all Language Models in DSPy, defining the interface for LM interactions. Adapters interact with instances of this class.

nodes.label: DSPy Signature (External)
nodes.title: Signature
nodes.description: Defines the input and output fields for a DSPy program step, guiding the adapter on how to format prompts and parse responses.

nodes.label: LM Request Format (External)
nodes.title: LMRequest
nodes.description: A standardized data structure representing a request to a Language Model, used by adapters to encapsulate all parameters for an LM call.

nodes.label: LM Response Format (External)
nodes.title: LMResponse
nodes.description: A standardized data structure representing the response from a Language Model, which adapters parse to extract structured outputs.

nodes.label: Pydantic Data Models (External)
nodes.title: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.description: An external library for data validation and settings management, heavily used by DSPy for defining structured inputs and outputs, especially by BAMLAdapter and Tool.

nodes.label: Chat Adapter (External)
nodes.title: ChatAdapter
nodes.description: An external adapter (likely a default or simple one) used by TwoStepAdapter for the second stage of structured data extraction from raw LM text.

groups.label: Surface Adapters
groups.title: User-Facing Adapters
groups.description: Adapters designed for specific use cases or enhanced formatting, directly used by DSPy programs.

groups.label: Core Adapter Logic
groups.title: Base Adapter Functionality
groups.description: The foundational class providing the common interface and pipeline for all LM interactions within DSPy.

groups.label: Custom Data Types
groups.title: Rich Data Structures for LMs
groups.description: Specialized data types that extend DSPy's capabilities to handle complex inputs and outputs like audio, code, documents, files, images, and tools.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: Integrated External Components
groups.description: Components from other DSPy modules or external libraries that the data adapters interact with.
